common.leave_prompt: Didn't ask for this, or changed your mind?

verify.subject: Confirm your email for Nowry
before: Hi,
Confirm that this address is yours and your Nowry account is complete.
after: If you didn't create a Nowry account, ignore this email. Nothing happens unless the link is opened.
verify.footer: Sent to $email because this address was used to sign up for Nowry.

reset.subject: Reset your Nowry password
before: Hi,
Someone asked to reset the password for the Nowry account with this address. If it was you, choose a new one here:
after: The link works once and for a short time. If you didn't ask, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.
reset.footer: Sent to $email because a password reset was requested for this address.

google.subject: Your Nowry account signs in with Google
before: Hi,

Someone asked to reset the password for the Nowry account with this address. This account signs in with Google, so it has no password to reset. You can sign in with Google, or set a password so you can also sign in with your email; you'll sign in with Google first:
after: If you didn't ask, ignore this email. Nothing has changed.
google.footer: Sent to $email because a password reset was requested for this address.

deleted.subject: Your Nowry account was deleted
before: Hi,
Your Nowry account was deleted. If this wasn't you, write to $support within 30 days.
deleted.footer: Sent to $email because the Nowry account with this address was deleted.

password.subject: Your Nowry password was changed
before: Hi,
Your Nowry password was changed. If this wasn't you, write to $support.
password.footer: Sent to $email because the password of the Nowry account with this address was changed.

confirm.subject: You're on the Nowry waitlist
before: Hi,
You asked for early access to Nowry. You're on the list.
Nowry turns what you read into flashcards and schedules every review, on the web and on Android. It is free during the beta.
We invite people in small groups. You will get one more email from us, with a link of your own, when your place opens.
confirm.footer: Sent to $email because this address was added to the Nowry waitlist.

account.subject: You already have a Nowry account
before: Hi,
This address was just entered on the Nowry waitlist, but it already has a Nowry account. There is no need to wait: sign in here.
after: If you signed up with Google, there is no password: use Sign in with Google.
If this wasn't you, ignore this email. Nothing has changed.
account.footer: Sent to $email because this address was entered on the Nowry waitlist.

invitation.subject: Your invitation to Nowry
before: Hi,
Your place in the Nowry beta is open. This invitation is for $email only. It works once, until $expires.
after: Testing the Android app? Create your account with this button first, then sign in on the app with the same address.
invitation.footer: Sent to $email because this address was invited to the Nowry beta.

ai_provider.subject: [Nowry] $provider is refusing requests; traffic went to $fallback
before: $provider refused a request at $time UTC ($reason).
Requests now go to $fallback, so the companion and card generation keep working. Top up or check $provider when you want it back. This alert repeats at most every 6 hours while it lasts.

ai_urgent.subject: [Nowry] URGENT: $provider failed and no AI provider is left
before: URGENT: $provider failed at $time UTC ($reason), and nothing is left behind it.
The companion and card generation fail for everyone until a provider answers again. Check the providers' status and credit.
